event.elara_heart2.0.text: Hold out your hand, [player]. No, the one you're hiding.
event.elara_heart2.0.why: a nurse who already caught you; the hiding is the joke

event.elara_heart2.1.text: That's a farm blister. I see ten a week. Bandage on. Don't argue, I'm faster than you.
event.elara_heart2.1.why: specific count, bossy-kind, punch at the end

event.elara_heart2.2.text: There! Good as new. And take this salad. The bandage was the treatment. Lunch is the follow-up!
event.elara_heart2.2.why: explains the salad gift as a medical pun

event.elara_heart5.0.text: I knitted something! For you! On purpose, this time.
event.elara_heart5.0.why: admits her knitting usually just happens to people

event.elara_heart5.1.text: It's a mitten with two thumbs, so it fits either hand. It's a bit crooked. Wear it anyway.

event.elara_heart5.2.text: You keep visiting when nothing hurts. Do you know how rare that is? Here. Cranberries. I can't knit those.
event.elara_heart5.2.why: the thanks said sideways, through the gift

event.past_the_point.1.text: I knitted a life jacket! Felix says that isn't how they work. I'm wearing it anyway. Over the real one.
event.past_the_point.1.why: same joke, now she is sensible underneath it

dlg.past_point.talk.0.text: My list is longer than the boat, and Felix says one place before breakfast. Which one?
dlg.past_point.talk.0.why: drops the count, which depends on the heart 8 choice

dlg.past_point.talk.c0.text: Round the headland. You've drawn it enough.

dlg.past_point.talk.c2.text: Straight out, till the shore's a line.

dlg.past_point.talk.r0.text: The headland! I've drawn it eleven times from the bench. Never from the water side!
dlg.past_point.talk.r0.why: the drawing habit, the first time on the water

dlg.past_point.talk.r1.text: The white rocks! I've never been closer than the bench. Row slowly, Felix. I want it to last.
dlg.past_point.talk.r1.why: wanting it to last is the real line

dlg.past_point.talk.r2.text: Straight out! I'll hold the sandwich tin. It's very steadying. Medically.
dlg.past_point.talk.r2.why: pun lands on the last word

event.past_the_point.2.text: The boat leaks, politely. Felix bails with one hand and rows with the other. His coffee never spills.

event.past_the_point.headland.text: The headland is twice the size the map said! Felix, it's enormous! Best thing I've ever been wrong about!
event.past_the_point.headland.why: her map was wrong and she is delighted

event.past_the_point.rocks.text: The white rocks look like teeth from here. Friendly teeth! Very good gums. May I wave at them?

event.past_the_point.horizon.text: The shore's just a line now. I didn't know I could feel this small and this glad at once.

dlg.elara.garden.visit.0.text: Good morning! You're the new farmer! I'm Elara, from the clinic. Am I the first to knock? I wanted to be first.
dlg.elara.garden.visit.0.why: too keen to help, as the matrix says

dlg.elara.garden.visit.1.text: Edmund brought me comfrey from this farm every spring, tied with garden twine. I've missed it. Oh, listen to me, rambling on your step.
dlg.elara.garden.visit.1.why: Edmund through one object; she catches herself

dlg.elara.garden.visit.2.text: Could I ask a favor? The clinic garden is bare soil this year. Three dandelions and three wild garlic would do it. Ordinary weeds. Wonderful poultice!

dlg.elara.garden.visit.r0.text: Thank you! Bring them to the clinic, or to me wherever I am. No hurry. Well, a small hurry. In the ground by the end of the week?

dlg.elara.garden.visit.r1.text: Of course! You've only just arrived. I'm at the clinic most days. Keep your socks on. The soil will wait.

event.elara_heart8.intro.text: Come see! It lives behind the kettle. I've never shown anyone. Don't laugh. Laugh a little.
event.elara_heart8.intro.why: pays off the paper behind the kettle from heart 2

dlg.elara.list.0.text: Elara unrolls a paper longer than the desk. It is covered in tiny writing and little doodled boats.
dlg.elara.list.0.why: a picture the player can see

dlg.elara.list.1.text: Places I've never been. Forty-one of them. Crossed off: none. ...Well? Say something before I roll it back up.

dlg.elara.list.c1.text: Add one more place to it.

dlg.elara.list.c2.text: Promise to visit. I'll even pack.

dlg.elara.list.r1.text: A new one! Forty-two! I'll draw it a tiny boat. You've made my whole week. Don't tell Dr. Penn.
dlg.elara.list.r1.why: the boat doodle, the secret kept

dlg.elara.list.r2.text: You promise? ...I'm writing that down. In ink. And I'll knit you a sock for the journey. Just the one, for luck.

event.elara_heart8.after.text: {if choice:list.pick}We picked one. The sea, from a boat. Circled twice, then once more in pen. Felix has a boat, you know.{else}{if choice:list.add}You added a place. It's in the margin: 'Somewhere [player] suggests.' It's already my favorite.{else}You promised. I'm holding you to it. Gently. With a very long scarf.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_heart8.after.why: each branch keeps its meaning; the pick branch points at Felix's boat

event.elara_birthday.intro.text: It's my birthday! I knitted myself a hat, and the hat has its own hat! Come in, come in!

dlg.elara.birthday.c1.text: That hat is magnificent. Both of them.

dlg.elara.birthday.c2.text: Beach day. Bring the hat's hat.

dlg.elara.birthday.r0.text: Thank you! I'm knitting that into my scarf. Every word. In red.

dlg.elara.birthday.r1.text: You noticed the small hat! Nobody notices the small hat! I'm so happy I might need a lie-down!

dlg.elara.birthday.r2.text: The beach! On my birthday! Yes! Dr. Penn can mind the plant. I'll pack a sandwich and a very long scarf!
dlg.elara.birthday.r2.why: the clinic plant and the scarf

event.elara_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.elara.wish}It's in the scarf now. Row nine hundred, in red, right under 'Felix waved'.{else}{if choice:bday.elara.hat}The hat's hat stays on. Dr. Penn pretended not to see it. She smiled at the wall.{else}The beach was perfect. I'm still sandy. I watched one boat the whole way out.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_birthday.after.why: small specifics; the beach branch keeps the boat want

event.elara_courtship.intro.text: I knitted a very long scarf, and the last row is a question. Would you court me? It's red. Red means very serious!
event.elara_courtship.intro.why: the joke and the question, the question first

event.elara_courtship2.intro.text: The scarf grew. A row a day, like I said. The last row still asks the same thing. Would you court me?
event.elara_courtship2.intro.why: a second ask that remembers the first

dlg.elara.courtship.0.text: Read the last row. Out loud, if you like. ...What do you say?
dlg.elara.courtship.0.why: shy pause before the shipped question

dlg.elara.courtship.r0.text: YES! Oh, my needles are shaking! The scarf is yours! All of it! I measured! It's very long!

dlg.elara.courtship.r1.text: Oh. ...Friends! The best kind! I'll knit you a friend-sized scarf. Same length, more pockets. Thank you for saying it kindly.
dlg.elara.courtship.r1.why: a beat of hurt, then real warmth

dlg.elara.courtship.r2.text: Think! Take all the time you need! I'll add a row a day. The scarf will just... get longer. That's fine!
dlg.elara.courtship.r2.why: the trailing off is the nerves

event.elara_courtship.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.elara.yes}Courting! We'll wear the scarf together. It's long enough for two. I checked. Twice.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.elara.friends}Friends, then. I'll knit it into the next row. In blue, so it's calm. Blue suits us.{else}Take your time. The scarf will keep. A row a day, behind the kettle, next to the list.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_courtship.after.why: drops 'ritual'; the scarf lives with the list

event.elara_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.elara.yes}Courting! We'll wear the scarf together. It's long enough for two now. All that waiting was knitting.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.elara.friends}Friends, then. I'll knit it into the next row. In blue, so it's calm. Blue suits us.{else}Still thinking? That's all right. I'll keep the scarf. It's warm, and it's patient. So am I.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_courtship2.after.why: the second ask closes the loop instead of repeating it

event.elara_partners.intro.text: Hello! I made you a hat! It has a smaller hat on it! And that one has a tiniest hat! Hats all the way down!

dlg.elara.partners.0.text: Dr. Penn gave me the afternoon off! She said 'go' twice, so I went. How shall we spend it?

dlg.elara.partners.c0.text: Put the hat on. All three.

dlg.elara.partners.c1.text: Teach me to knit a row.

dlg.elara.partners.c2.text: Beach walk, till the sun goes down.

dlg.elara.partners.r0.text: Oh, you look wonderful! The tiniest hat is crooked. It's perfect. I'm a little teary. Happy teary!

dlg.elara.partners.r1.text: Hold this needle! No, the other end! There! We made a row! It's the best row in Wetherell!

dlg.elara.partners.r2.text: The beach at sunset! I'll bring a blanket and three snacks. The snacks are yours. The blanket is ours.

event.elara_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.elara.hat}The hat lives on my shelf now, with its smaller hats. We're all very close.{else}{if choice:courtship.elara.knit}Our row is the middle of the scarf. It's crooked. It's my favorite part.{else}The sunset was pink. So was I. We counted boats. Someday one of them is ours.{/if}{/if}
event.elara_partners.after.why: beach branch keeps the boat want alive

event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l1.text: Dr. Penn! Don't look at the waiting room stool! It is absolutely not wearing a cozy!

event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l3.text: You like it! A cozy for the stool, and next, a smaller cozy for the cozy!

event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l1.text: Soup for the whole clinic! Seven vegetables! One of them is a surprise!

event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l3.text: The turnip! It's dressed as a carrot! Very brave of it!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l3.why: the waiting-room bravery joke, given to a turnip

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l1.text: Dr. Penn, eleven hours yesterday. I counted. So I knitted you a sleeping mask! Lavender!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l1.why: care disguised as a craft project

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l3.text: Ten minutes is a perfect nap! I'll mind the desk. I'll answer nothing, kindly!
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l3.why: the nap joke, her own kind of medicine

event.overheard_felix_elara_1.l2.text: Then it's a very loose net! Free and comfortable! Everybody wins!

event.overheard_felix_elara_1.l4.text: I knew you'd love it! Next one's bigger. Big enough for the boat!
event.overheard_felix_elara_1.l4.why: points at Felix's boat, her want

event.overheard_felix_elara_2.l2.text: I made a scarf that big! Same size exactly! They'd be friends!
event.overheard_felix_elara_2.l2.why: matches his fish story with hers

event.overheard_felix_elara_2.l4.text: Too late! I told the whole waiting room!
event.overheard_felix_elara_2.l4.why: the waiting room as her village square

event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l2.text: Seventeen, eighteen! It isn't counting, it's a rhythm!

event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l4.text: I won't! Nineteen! Twenty! Fish are the best listeners. They never interrupt.
event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l4.why: a kind tease that lands on Felix's quiet

adds.text: Oh! That paper behind the kettle? Nothing. A map. Of places I haven't been. Yet!
adds.why: plants the map behind the kettle; ends on 'Yet'

adds.text: Someday I'll show you my list. Not today. It's very long, and it has drawings.
adds.why: names the list and points at heart 8

threads.elara_heart2: What is the map behind the clinic kettle, and where are the places she hasn't been?
threads.elara_heart5: Elara has a long list with drawings she is not ready to show yet.
threads.past_the_point: One place crossed off; the rest of the list, and Felix's one leaky boat, are still waiting.
threads.elara_garden_visit: Edmund brought Elara comfrey every spring; where on the farm did it grow?
threads.elara_heart8: Forty-one places, a boat to find, and Felix is the one with a boat.
threads.elara_birthday: Elara watched a boat go out, or kept your words in a scarf that keeps growing.
threads.elara_courtship: The scarf keeps growing behind the kettle next to the list, a row a day.
threads.elara_courtship2: The scarf is finished or still patient; either way it waits behind the kettle.
threads.elara_partners: Someday one of the boats is theirs.
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_1: How far will the cozies go, and how long will Dr. Penn pretend not to like them?
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_3: Will Dr. Penn really nap for ten minutes, and who minds the clinic when she does?
threads.overheard_felix_elara_1: A net big enough for Felix's boat: Elara has her eye on that boat.
threads.overheard_felix_elara_3: Elara knits by the sea at sunrise with Felix; what is she counting toward?

notes: elara_courtship and elara_courtship2 share dlg.elara.courtship.*; I rewrote those once and gave each scene its own intro and after line (courtship2 now remembers the first ask).
Cut 'It's a ritual' from the courtship after line (horror-adjacent word in a cozy scene).

dlg.elara.partners.0 said 'Clinic's closed' but the scene plays 9 to 17 on clinic days; now Dr. Penn gave her the afternoon. past_point.talk.0 no longer states a list count, because it is 41 or 42 depending on the heart 8 choice.
